title: Major upgrades to your lessons and AI tutor
body:
Thanks to some very honest feedback from a student, we've made major improvements. Here's what you'll notice:

• A more accurate tutor. It works from every slide you've covered, so its answers match your lesson.

• Practice questions that line up with what you just learned, with a quick recap every few slides and the option to practise with the tutor.

• A cleaner lesson screen. The tutor opens beside the slide when you want it and remembers your conversation.

Jump into a lesson and try it. Thoughts? Use the feedback box below. I read every one.
